name: custom-agent
description: Multi-agent orchestration (2 skills): tamandua-agents (drive Tamandua, a local CLI/workflow orchestrator on top of pi — workflow runs, step lifecycle, worktrees, dashboard/control-plane services, logs, pause/resume, AutoResearch experiment loops, and the STATUS output contract) and graphify (turn any input — code, docs, papers, images, videos — into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools).
